audit.whatIsWrong: Content win[0..6] names Heimerdinger favored for all 7 rows (matching content whys[0..6], which are all grounded, Heimerdinger-specific reasons), but full phases[0..6].side all say the generic 'Skill' template and phases[N].why is a copy-pasted level-curve template unrelated to Heimerdinger's actual kit.
audit.why: Turret zoning (H-28G) plus the CH-2 Grenade stun answers Tristana's jump at every stage, and content's own whys already document this correctly stage by stage. The full layer never caught up.
audit.corrected: Moved all 7 phases[N].side to Heimerdinger (win[N] already agrees, so side is edited alone per the chart rule) and rewrote phases[N].why to restate content's grounded per-stage reasons instead of the generic template.

audit.why: Content spikes correctly track Heimerdinger's power curve: turret zoning early, Upgrade!!! at 6 turning E into a wide stun, siege power holding through items.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns has no real cooldown number (packet defect: 'no cooldown-sequencing advice anywhere'). CH-2 Grenade is a flat 11s cooldown and turrets recast every 1s — neither number appears.
audit.why: The kit gives E a flat 11s cooldown and Q a 1s recast; stating them lets the reader count the actual punish window instead of a vague 'downtime'.
audit.corrected: Rewrote breakdown.cooldowns with both real numbers and a concrete sequencing line.

edits.before: Contest level 1 autos — your early range is real and the all-in threat starts at 2; set the tone.
edits.after: H-28G turrets out-range and out-trade your autos at level 1 — Heimerdinger owns the wave from minute one.

edits.before: Jump-bomb all-ins open: W in off any support CC and the E detonation math is already rude.
edits.after: His turret plus CH-2 Grenade poke keeps chipping you at level 2 while your jump isn't ready to punish him.

edits.before: Full kit: E the target, stack it with autos, and R the finish — the lane's most honest kill threat.
edits.after: Even with W up you can't dash past his zone without eating the grenade stun — CH-2 shuts the jump down.

edits.before: Trade around the bomb: four stacks detonate — back off at three or commit at four; never linger between.
edits.after: His turret field zones your CS through levels 4-5 and denies safe last-hitting.

edits.before: Buster Shot peels or executes — the knockback flips dives both directions.
edits.after: Upgrade!!! turns E into a wide stun and the turret into a mini-laser — it hard-counters your Buster Shot engage.

edits.before: First item spike: the jump-bomb-R string deletes squishies and the resets chain through fights.
edits.after: His turrets still outrange your safe farm and his poke out-sustains you even after your first item.

edits.before: Late Trist jumps the resets: E the carry, R the peel, and jump out — or in — on every takedown.
edits.after: He becomes a siege-and-zone monster whose stun cancels your reset dive — the lane stays his through items.

edits.before: E the bomb, stack two autos, and step back at three — the threat does the zoning and the fourth stack stays loaded.
edits.after: Wait for the panic bomb spam to whiff, then E your own bomb and stack two autos before he resets his rotation.

edits.before: Jumping in with the bomb unstacked and R down — Tristana without the string is a yordle tourist at a gunfight.
edits.after: Diving the nest solo just walks you into three turret beams plus the grenade stun — bring the duo or don't go.

edits.before: - Heimerdinger CH-2 Grenade (Stun): matchup-defining — The stun makes his turret nest lethal — dodge it before committing anything. Step up only on its downtime. - Budget W Rocket Jump (reset) for emergencies and the R for opportunities — never swap them.
edits.after: - CH-2 Grenade (E) is a flat 11s cooldown — dodge it, then you have 11 seconds to step up before it's back. Turrets (Q) recast every 1s, so kill the turret itself, not just the poke. - Budget W Rocket Jump for emergencies and the R for opportunities — never swap them.
